name: Factory Pro

meters.label: 5-hour window
meters.hint: Run /limits in Droid, or Settings → Usage.

reset.rule: Opens at your first Droid request and resets 5 hours later.
stipulations: A request needs room in all three windows (5 hours, 7 days, 30 days).
Each model spends usage at its multiplier: Claude Opus 5.5 1.6x, Sonnet 5.5 0.8x, GPT-6.2 Sol 0.8x, Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna 0.04x.

meters.label: 7-day window
meters.hint: Run /limits in Droid, or Settings → Usage.

reset.rule: Opens at your first Droid request and resets 7 days later.
stipulations: Droid Core models have their own separate limits.

meters.label: 30-day window
meters.hint: Run /limits in Droid, or Settings → Usage.

reset.rule: Opens at your first Droid request and resets 30 days later.

overage: At a limit the current request finishes, then later ones fail with a rate-limit error. Run /limits to switch to Droid Core models or to Extra Usage. Extra Usage is prepaid USD credit, $10 minimum, that never expires. Once on, it stays on until you turn it off or it runs out.

how: Three rolling windows (5 hours, 7 days, 30 days) that start at first use. Factory publishes no sizes.
Each model spends usage at its own multiplier.
ext: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok and open models (Droid Core) at Factory's multipliers.
Bring-your-own-key works only on the Free plan. Free also accepts ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway logins.
quirks: Standard Tokens are gone. Pro used to include 20M a month (third-party report, unconfirmed).
Factory's docs call Droid Core free in one place and say it uses Standard Usage in another.
Missions need Extra Usage turned on and pause at a limit.

modelTable.title: Factory: usage multipliers
modelTable.note: A model at 2x uses your windows twice as fast as one at 1x.
modelTable.footer: Gemini 4 Carbon, Argon and 3.8 Flash rates are marked promotional.
